text: The kingdom woke up. The lights came back on. Everyone cheered for the brave girl who had saved them all. And Luna finally understood what Mum had always told her. Her power was never just the starlight in her hands. Her real power was being herself — and the love she had for Cheeto and her mum.

text: So Luna became the kindest Queen the galaxy had ever known. She wore her royal cape — but always over her favourite hoodie. She kept her long plait.
